items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1959-12-09
items.q: Me and Willie Umphrey had a little band together, then Walter Pichon on the piano.

ctx.x: That was a fella named Hutchison. He was a swell musician. He was a British, Honduras fella. He'd come here to New Orleans on a visit, you know, and stayed around and at the same time he wanted to play, you know. He didn't have no instrument with him. He was a baritone player. He learned how to play good in school. He was a fine musician. He said, if you got a mellophone anywhere around you, the fella said, yeah, we can get you one. It was young Willie. Young Willie.
